lead.headline: SEC custody proposal and $1B XRP treasury deal signal institutional normalization even as exchange security collapses
lead.tldr: Today's signals reveal a market splitting in two: institutional infrastructure advancing through regulatory and corporate treasury channels, while centralized exchange security deteriorates into the worst month on record. The gap between regulated on-ramps and unguarded trading venues is becoming the defining risk-reward axis.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks the widening divergence between institutional-grade crypto infrastructure and the crumbling security perimeter of centralized exchanges.

top_signals.title: Bitget’s $388M hack pushes Q3 crypto security losses past $1B
top_signals.summary: A massive $388 million hack of Bitget has pushed total crypto security losses for Q3 beyond the $1 billion mark. This event highlights ongoing systemic vulnerabilities within centralized exchange security.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Bitget breach confirms that exchange security has not scaled with asset prices, making counterparty selection the highest-conviction decision in any crypto allocation.

top_signals.title: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut
top_signals.summary: Evernorth shareholders have approved a $1 billion XRP treasury deal, which is a key step toward the company's planned Nasdaq debut. The company already holds approximately 347 million XRP tokens ahead of the final closing of the deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Evernorth's shareholder approval demonstrates that corporate treasury adoption of crypto is moving from speculative pilot to balance-sheet mechanics with real IPO implications.

top_signals.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
top_signals.summary: September 2026 saw a surge in crypto hacks, totaling over $766 million in losses. This marks the worst month of the year, highlighted by major breaches at Bitget and Liquid Network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: September's $768M in hacks establishes a new baseline for insurable risk pricing and will likely accelerate demand for self-custody solutions and qualified custodians.

top_signals.title: EU questions Binance over continued operations despite wind-down order
top_signals.summary: EU securities regulators are questioning Binance regarding its continued operations despite a previous wind-down order. The investigation focuses on whether the exchange is improperly utilizing legal exemptions to maintain its presence in the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Binance's regulatory friction in the EU suggests that exchange market share will increasingly flow to venues with explicit regulatory authorization, repricing liquidity premiums.

top_signals.title: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto Custody requirements have kept some investment advisers from offering certain crypto to clients, a regulatory hurdle the SEC’s proposal could remove.
top_signals.summary: The SEC is proposing changes to custody requirements that currently prevent many investment advisers from offering crypto assets to their clients. If passed, this move would remove a significant regulatory hurdle for institutional adoption.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The SEC custody proposal, if finalized, removes the single largest structural barrier preventing RIAs from allocating client capital to crypto, with direct implications for AUM flows.

deals.summary: Nubank has halted acquisition talks with UK-based fintech Monzo following a plunge in sales. The potential deal would have valued Monzo between £8bn and £10bn.

on_the_radar.title: Hyperliquid Policy Center, Circle press EU on perps and stablecoin reserves in MiCA review
on_the_radar.summary: The Hyperliquid Policy Center and Circle are lobbying the EU regarding the MiCA regulatory framework. Hyperliquid argues that perpetuals should be classified as derivatives under MiFID II, while Circle seeks to remove the bank deposit floor for stablecoin reserves.

on_the_radar.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
on_the_radar.summary: Regulators from New York and Wyoming have signed a pact to coordinate cryptocurrency oversight. The agreement allows firms regulated in one state for at least three years to receive expedited licensing reviews in the other.

on_the_radar.title: Lloyds, Visa settle $750,000 using USDC in live cross-border pilot
on_the_radar.summary: Lloyds and Visa successfully completed a live cross-border pilot settling $750,000 using USDC. The trial demonstrated the ability to move funds in under an hour, including during weekend hours.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum’s zkAPI brings privacy-preserving API payments to mainnet
on_the_radar.summary: Ethereum's zkAPI has officially launched on the mainnet. The tool utilizes zero-knowledge proofs to decouple API payment transactions from user identities, enhancing privacy for developers and users.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI to let users pay for AI models without revealing identity
on_the_radar.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has launched zkAPI, a system allowing users to pay for AI models while maintaining their anonymity. The project was developed in collaboration with the Open Anonymity Project based on a design proposed by Vitalik Buterin and Davide Crapis.

on_the_radar.title: 50,000 Europeans call on EU to ease stablecoin rewards restrictions in MiCA review
on_the_radar.summary: Approximately 50,000 European citizens are urging the EU to ease restrictions on stablecoin rewards during the MiCA regulatory review. This push comes as EU central banks simultaneously seek broader modifications to the existing framework.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood Wallet integrates Arcus RFQ system for stock token swaps
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood Wallet has integrated the Arcus RFQ system to facilitate stock token swaps. This integration allows eligible users to access Arcus's liquidity and execution infrastructure for trading tokenized stocks.

on_the_radar.title: Binance’s EU services face scrutiny over licensing exemption: Report
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is facing scrutiny regarding its licensing exemptions in the EU after withdrawing its MiCA application in Greece. Reports suggest the exchange is instead serving some EU traders through its regulated entity in Abu Dhabi.

worth_a_read.title: Nubank halts Monzo acquisition talks after sales plunge
worth_a_read.note: The Nubank-Monzo breakdown offers a live case study in how fintech M&A valuation bridges collapse when growth narratives crack, with direct read-across to crypto exchange consolidation timing.

worth_a_read.title: The Behavior of Polymarket Traders
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's analysis of Polymarket trader behavior provides empirical grounding on how prediction market liquidity forms and whether crypto-native venues can sustain institutional-caliber price discovery.

linkedin_post:
Three hundred eighty-eight million from Bitget. Seven hundred sixty-eight million in September alone. These are not outliers anymore; they are the current cost of using centralized exchanges without qualified custodial infrastructure. We have been underwriting crypto exposure on the assumption that exchange security would improve with scale. The Q3 data kills that assumption cold.

Against this, the SEC is moving to let investment advisers custody crypto directly for clients. Evernorth shareholders just approved a billion-dollar XRP treasury position ahead of Nasdaq. The market is not waiting for exchange security to catch up. It is building parallel rails.

The repricing here is in counterparty risk, not asset class risk. We underwrite crypto allocations now on whether the custody chain terminates at a regulated bank, a qualified custodian, or an exchange hot wallet. That distinction used to be marginal. After September, it is the whole spread.

The test: if the SEC custody rule finalizes before year-end, watch whether RIAs move fast or treat it as a 2027 story. Their speed will tell us whether institutional demand is pent-up or still theoretical.
